rationale: Core NBRSM payment-statistics landing page with the fullest ATM/POS/card tables; central to A4 market statistics.
English mirror of the same payment-statistics section; monitor with the MK parent but keep for English labels and release calendar.
Dedicated payment-cards page giving issuance and acceptance-network series not duplicated elsewhere.
A single card-report PDF; valuable as evidence and as proof of the /WBStorage/Files naming pattern, not a recurring feed.
MIPS RTGS operator page — recurring wholesale payment turnover/participant statistics.
KIBS retail net-settlement oversight page; distinct retail payment volume series and pointer to KIBS AD as an actor.
Static structural map of the national payment infrastructure; mine once for actor list, low ongoing signal.
Statutory register of payment institutions, e-money issuers and payment system operators — durable registry defining the regulated perimeter.
Quarterly bank-by-bank indicator XLSX tables; baseline denominators for payments market sizing.
Recurring English banking-system report series with card and digital-channel sections.
Annual financial stability reports carry payment-system risk and cash-usage chapters; recurring publication series.
Annual reports contain the consolidated statutory account of MIPS/KIBS turnover and card infrastructure.
Quarterly macro reports overlap the annual/stability series; useful but covered by monitoring the NBRSM publications parent.
Monthly monetary statistics including currency in circulation — the canonical cash-usage series.
Verified PxWeb database with documented API; best automatable ingestion point for NBRSM time series.
Banknotes/coins in circulation pages underpin cash-cycle, ATM demand and denomination-mix analysis.
Predictable monthly press-release PDF directory; cheapest robust monthly harvest of official money/currency signals.
Payment services law and by-laws define reporting obligations and forthcoming series; regulatory corpus worth watching for amendments.
National Payment System Council page yields strategy documents and an actor map; mine for leads, occasional refresh.
Top-level statistics hub and release calendar — canonical crawl entry point for detecting new datasets.
Generic financial-system overview page; context only and covered by the NBRSM parent.
Exchange-office register is only an indirect cash-intensity proxy; mine once if cash analysis needs it.
Verified national statistical office portal; entry point to releases, calendar and MAKStat for payments-demand denominators.
Verified MAKStat PxWeb database with API and CSV/JSON exports — best structured feed for retail and ICT series.
Annual household ICT survey is the only official measure of online purchasing, internet banking and online payment behaviour.
Enterprise ICT/e-commerce release archive gives merchant online-sales and online-payment acceptance denominators.
Monthly retail/wholesale turnover series; standard macro proxy for card-payment volume and cash-vs-card mix.
SSO open-data/API index gives a lower-friction machine ingest path than HTML scraping.
